The fact that the one known as Jesus the Christ descended in what is called hell into that of the burning fires of Hades, is another way of seeing how advanced this particular entity was in its own unique experience that may or may not be shared by anyone else.
excerpts.q: Oh, yes. A follow-up query involves the example of some Christian denominations [who] claim that everybody follows in the footsteps of Jesus, as expressed through some Christian acts of belief or prayers of belief, statements of belief. Jesus was crucified, died, and was buried. He descended into hell, and on the third day, he rose again. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and we are aware of your query, my brother. This is a kind of transition that has many definitions or descriptions, much as the gem has many facets in its being. We would suggest that there is a basic experience as one moves from the physical body and into the light. This light then shines upon the entity moving into it in a fashion which allows it to move as far as is comfortable within that light, and when it is uncomfortable to move further, then there is the movement away into the level of vibration that is most comfortable for the entity moving into the light.
excerpts.q: Yes. Q’uo. Various spiritual traditions ranging from conservative Christianity, to Hinduism, Buddhism, Sikhism, and a million others, all describe the physical passing from this life and what happens next in different outcomes. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and am aware of your query, my brother. It is something that is very unlikely, in our opinion, but we are not without failure in our ability to perceive the correct portion of a journey of any spiritual seeker. But it would seem that the medicine itself being crystallized would simply be crystallizing the paper upon which the message has been written. If the person needing the healing is open to such a need for healing, this could be used as a means of healing. It is something that much consideration would need to be taken by the one seeking to offer the healing.
excerpts.q: I can’t help but ask, is it possible for medicines to be crystallized in the way a person can?

excerpts.t: In order to clear and balance these energy centers, is well to look to each one as a means by which you can balance the energies that you perceive as being within the red-ray chakra that energy that is a portion of one’s sexual experience, one’s need to survive within your third-density world, or indeed, within any portion of the one infinite creation.
excerpts.q: Yes, I have a query. This is something that has been covered before, and G and I kind of shared this one, but I just needed some more clarification, and that is: how do you go about clearing your lower energy centers, especially? I believe I know how to do it and I but I would just like to have a further comment from Q’uo on this, if you would.

excerpts.t: It is just a circumstance that a veil has been dropped, so to speak, within your deep mind that creates a seeming partition of awareness and experience between that which becomes the conscious mind and that which in, or more in tune with, time/space, becomes the subconscious mind. For the seeker who begins to penetrate that veil of forgetting that they may begin to perceive and indeed even experience that great realm of time/space, many doors begin to open in the possibilities of work in consciousness.
excerpts.q: Q’uo I’ve always had a problem understanding the nature of time in time/space. In our existence, it’s a straight line, past, present, future. Is there some analogy you can give us that might help us understand how time behaves in time/space?

excerpts.t: And thus, if this realization is come to through the open heart, love is a natural product of this realization, for you cannot separate [from] an other-self in order to feel anything besides love for that other. The unity that you realize implies care and acceptance and understanding, even if that is not your lived experience.
excerpts.q: How does love emerge from unity, Quo?

excerpts.t: Many of your peoples pray for peace, for harmony, for healing, for a new journey, or other concerns, and these prayers are heard by many. Many of them are what you would call angels, and they respond to prayers by moving to the area of concern and sharing their love and light of the Creator in any manner that might be effective in the area that is being prayed for or the person or the situation. They are then able to move further within the life pattern of whatever person or group they have been sent to, or prayed to respond to, and give of themselves the qualities that have been prayed for to those that need them.
excerpts.q: I have a query Q’uo. I would like to ask you about angels and the angelic soul. I would like to know if there are angels that are in human form, that walk the earth, and if so, would you say that their souls are of the angelic realm?

excerpts.t: By engaging with gratitude, you are able to open this door more and more so that the light and love of the Creator becomes more and more apparent to you in your day to day life. The pathways of love from the Creator are broadened as you explore this unique perspective on love. We correlate gratitude to love because it is indeed an act of love and acceptance and acknowledgement, that what you experience is in harmony with your being and is being offered to you from a seemingly external place.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. Thank you so much for being here today and helping us with our questions. My question is, how does gratitude help with our service to others?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and we thank you, my brother. And we appreciate this query, for it is quite deep and relevant to the experience of many within your third density. The nature of the veil within your third density is that of obfuscation, where the linkage between those sensations of the body, both pleasant and unpleasant, comfortable and painful, are not immediately recognized to be also relevant to your emotional being and to your inner being. It is very easy within your third density to view the body as simply a vessel that you are inhabiting, rather than an aspect of your own being.
excerpts.q: Yeah, I have a query Q’uo. I have a lot of physical pain that is stored in my body. I know it’s related to emotional catalyst that hasn’t properly been dealt with, and I find great relief in seeking help from a practitioner of acupuncture. My question is, how can I more efficiently integrate my catalysts? And how does this catalyst work with the secondary and tertiary energy fields of the body? […]

excerpts.t: To contemplate gratitude within your own being is to open a doorway that allows the love of the Creator to flow through and to bless those aspects of your life that you have come to realize, through the process of gratitude, are gifts from the Creator to the Creator.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. Thank you so much for being here today and helping us with our questions. My question is, how does gratitude help with our service to others?

excerpts.t: When this occurs, we suggest to the seeker to turn inward into the heart and not to attempt to force a perception of love, but to touch again that desire to find love, and recognize that this is the desire of the Creator. And that in touching it, you can find love within that moment through the fact that you desire to find it.
excerpts.q: Yes, one of the most beautiful things you talk about is finding the love in the moment. And there are some spans of time when it’s very easy to have that mindset, and then other spans of time where it’s easy to become overwhelmed by emotion or just fall into routine. Do you have any guidance for staying more mindful of the mindset, of seeking the love in the moment?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of the query, my brother. And we would point out that within this query is the ever-present dynamic of the third density. For if holding love and discovering love in the moment were easy, even for the seeker who has walked the path through many incarnations, then the gifts of third density would not be available to the seeker. For it is in the difficulty, it is in the contrast and the friction where the essential quality of experience that the Creator is seeking can be found. For the Creator has cast out its creation in this attempt to hide from Itself and Its true nature, [that which] you may identify within the third density as love. If love were already apparent, the Creator would not be able to play this game of life with Itself. […]
excerpts.q: Yes, one of the most beautiful things you talk about is finding the love in the moment. And there are some spans of time when it’s very easy to have that mindset, and then other spans of time where it’s easy to become overwhelmed by emotion or just fall into routine. Do you have any guidance for staying more mindful of the mindset, of seeking the love in the moment?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of the query, my brother. We would begin our response with a concept that we understand is quite familiar to you and to this group, and that is that the origin of these thoughts and inner feelings comes from one source. And that source is the One Infinite Creator, the source of all things. And so from the grandest perspective, no matter where it seems your thoughts may come from, it is all one source. And that source is full of love and light, no matter how it presents itself to you. It may be wearing certain masks and disguises at various times that hide that love and that light, but they come to you with that love and light asking to be recognized within them.
excerpts.q: Yes, I have one. I’m attempting to figure out where my thoughts are coming from in my head or are they coming from the dark side or is it just a silly thing that I do with my thoughts, which is basically run around in circles. […]

excerpts.t: If in your estimation you are feeling called to that great and central discipline of formal meditation and to feel that it is being neglected in your life, then this is good grist for the mill, that is, it is good material for you to examine. Are you feeling such a call because of an idea that you had absorbed from some source like ours or elsewhere that you, the entity, must be meditating and thus feel friction when not engaged in this practice? Or is it that you see that your own objectives—namely and most broadly self-realization and service to others—may be effectuated by this practice known as meditation? One must suss this out for the self and find out what the beliefs or the limitations of belief are, and follow the heart accordingly.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I all too frequently recognize that I do not spend nearly enough time in meditation, but I do spend time reading materials that tend to be spiritually motivational. I’m aware that it would be far more worthwhile to spend reading time in meditation [instead]. […]

excerpts.t: And again, those are valid experiences. We see the despair, we see the fear. We also see the love. We see the excitement. Hold in your hearts, at your center, that what you truly desire from this illusion is love, that the lessons you hope to learn were ones of love, were ones of the kind of love that is unconditional, and that is what you shall manifest. For all things are that love, even those painful moments that try and challenge you, even those joyful moments that bring tears to your eyes.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, I would like to ask about our current political environment in the United States. We know that it affects all inhabitants of the Earth. How do we come to an acceptance, and how do we bring love to all of the changes? How do we bring courage to all of the changes that are before us?

excerpts.t: We would reflect the dynamic in this query of the guilt that you have expressed in yourself and the seeing a need for healing of an other-self, and point out that the guilt that you feel is, in its own way, a wound asking to be healed. As you are looking outward in an attempt to serve others admirably, there is a world inside of you that is also asking for healing, and that situations like this do not arise by coincidence. When you perceive a circumstance that you feel called to service to others within, and that calling generates within you a certain angst or guilt or feelings of inadequacy or lack of self-worth, an incapability to rise to the task, [remember that] this is all a divine creation of catalyst. […]
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I had a question around healing. In the Law of One, it talks about healing and physical healing, and I find that there’s almost a guilt in me that is forming based on current situations, that if only I would spend more time studying healing, that maybe I could be of more service to others. […]

excerpts.t: We would reflect to you how meaningful it is that an entity within your third density would desire so strongly to serve another in healing that it generates guilt within them. This itself is indicative of the heart of a seeker that desires intensely to share the love and light of the Creator within an environment that is designed to make the discovery of this love and light a challenge, a difficulty, but here you are. The desire itself is an expression of love. The fact that you recognize that you feel guilt is because of the heart that you have opened.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I had a question around healing. excerpts.t: We admire the vulnerability created by the joining of these open hearts, and would comment upon the nature of love as you have discovered it and shared it today. Love does not always need to feel pleasant and comfortable. In order to truly love within the third density, one opens themselves to the difficulty and pain of loss of the connections that you forge here in grappling with the nature of third density, and how love can be so intense and powerful that it carries you high, but can also bring you down and help you to realize that all of it is love, not just the pleasantness, but the pain that you feel inside of you comes from your open heart. It is part of your journey here in the third density to honor the process of love as it unfolds within your being, as you move through the illusion.
excerpts.q: Healing and guilt; realizing one’s potential; the current political environment of the USA.

Does that mean injuries on the left side are a message that we need to be more intuitive? […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo and am aware of your query, my sister. Fear is the other side of the coin of love. Fear can become catalyst that when you can describe or discover the cause of fear within your being, you can work with that fear to discover greater portions of your own being that fear has kind of, what we would say, locked down or minimized. For that which you fear seems to be other than who you are, which is the One Infinite Creator in, what we might call, a stepped-down nature. You are a young Creator, and you can grow more and more into your full Creatorship as you work with whatever it is that you fear at any point in your spiritual journey. For there may be fears of one kind or another that serve as catalyst, as stepping stones, to help you move further on your spiritual path. This is also seen as the food for growth.
excerpts.q: Hello Q’uo. What’s the nature of my fear, the fear in my life, and how can I transform it into love and collective empowerment?

excerpts.t: Now another element to releasing that fear is the exercising of faith. The knowledge that you are always and ever held by the Creator. That everything is perfectly imperfect. That every experience is intentional. That everything is divinely designed to provide the catalyst whereby the choice of love is made. That is ultimate faith. That is the practice of faith. That is the empowerment of faith.
excerpts.q: I’m very grateful to be here with you and be here with the group. My question has to do with the fear that we have all been talking about today, and how we can best be of service to help all of our fellow brothers and sisters work through their own fears as well as our own. […]

excerpts.t: So whatever you fear, face it, embrace it. Look into its being, its origin, how you can accept that which is feared as being a beautiful part of yourself—another piece in the puzzle of the One Creator that exists within your being. Then your love expands to experience and accept more of you and who you are until your nature of being, at some point in this incarnation or a further incarnation, shall once again become unified with the One Infinite Creator.
excerpts.q: Hello Q’uo. What’s the nature of my fear, the fear in my life, and how can I transform it into love and collective empowerment?

excerpts.t: Every step on this journey was predesigned by those who walk it to give you these experiences, whereby you learn more of yourself as the Creator and more of other-self as that same Creator. Simply walking that path with that other-self, listening, hearing—truly hearing, understanding and accepting, and sharing your own light are ways to assist the self and the other-self from these spaces of darkness and into the greater light of what you may call reality, that being the loving expanse of the creation.
excerpts.q: I’m very grateful to be here with you and be here with the group. My question has to do with the fear that we have all been talking about today, and how we can best be of service to help all of our fellow brothers and sisters work through their own fears as well as our own. […]

excerpts.t: We are Laitos and are aware of the query and appreciate the opportunity to speak upon our own service and beingness. We are those of the fourth density with a very explicit mission to aid those upon your planet and other planets in bridging the gap of consciousness between your third-density selves and those of higher densities. This is a service that we are quite well acquainted with and have practiced much on our own journeys.
excerpts.q: Laitos, thanks for visiting this group today. It is well to hear from you. One question, or at least one for now. What is your role in facilitating our next step in the journey? Why are you here with us today?

excerpts.t: As we sense the energy within this group and assess the discussion from before we joined you through this instrument, we would emphasize that there are many entities awaiting the opportunity to connect with you in a more direct way. Many of these entities have interacted with you in more subtle ways, whether through the dreaming, through the day-dreaming, through the subtle inspiration, through the whispers and hints given to you through your intuition. It is through this portal that any energies and entities and intelligences from outside of your discrete, illusory boundary may present themselves to you. And this process of channeling, as you call it, is simply that of tuning in to that portal that is ever present within you and is always open to various influences, though typically is more limited to those influences from your own unconscious beingness.
excerpts.q: Opening to new (presumably) Confederation sources.

excerpts.t: But as those surface levels are bridged to the deeper levels within the self, there is a sensitizing of the being itself and a greater unity of resonance within the being as the hard walls become more permeable to the light.
excerpts.q: Yeah, I think I have a question that might help the next two instruments. I felt conditioning similar to how experienced conditioning when I first started channeling with this connection. And I know that that conditioning has not been typical of our experience channeling lately. I know that Gary has mentioned not feeling much in the way of sensations, in terms of conditioning. […]

excerpts.t: And so, we would now give this instrument the opportunity to connect with a voice outside of ourselves. And we would invite her to take this moment to go deeper, to open the heart, and to invite that which desires to speak. We are those of Laitos.
excerpts.q: We thank you, the known as Austin, and offer that among our specialties and strengths is that of the healing of war, the mending of hearts, the constant attempt to beam mercy to those caught in cycles of retribution and bellicosity. […]

excerpts.t: The disadvantages [are] that, with the monastic atmosphere, there is less interaction within other circles of being, such as this circle, or the community, the workplace, anywhere that there may be interactions with other facets of the Creator that can provide catalyst, as you may call it, that seem to knock you off your center of loving all around you. And this type of catalyst can be food for growth, further growth through having to process the catalyst and to discover that what was difficult has made you expand your nature of yourself, your image, your expression, and to find that food for growth continuously, and many other such experiences where catalyst is provided.
excerpts.q: If no one else does… [pause] going once, going twice. Then Q’uo, I have a question. The Creator can be sought in any circumstance and through modes as unique as the person, but what is the value of the monastic life for the seeker of the Creator? What advantages does it offer?

excerpts.t: As to our response to such efforts, as you may imagine, we are not want to infringe upon the free will of your peoples, and must always take into account that very careful, always dynamic balance of the free will of your population. This is not, on our part, a politeness or timidity, but is rather a deep respect for the fundamental laws of governance and operation of the universe itself which demands that the entity, at whatever stage of their evolution, from the first density onward through the third and upward, exercise their own will to discover that which they seek, that which they wish to create, that which they wish to manifest. However confused or uninformed or divided that free will may be, such is the sovereign duty of each manifest thing in creation which is imbued with this prime directive to use free will to walk their own journey.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I was wondering if you could provide the Confederation’s view on CE5 contact protocols, which is the use of meditation and sending love and light out in the form of an invitation to make visual contact with an entity or craft. And is it possible that the Confederation answers that call?

excerpts.t: As this system of refining and constraining the boundaries of experience and potential continued, what has been identified as the veil of forgetting was discovered, and an illusory boundary was placed between the conscious mind and the unconscious mind, and between the mind/body/spirit, causing it to form into the mind/body/spirit complex. These things appearing to be separate, but only in an illusory sense.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a question. The Christian Bible has actually several creation stories, and their origins are questionable. Can you provide an accurate explanation of the or the origin, creation, of our species?

excerpts.t: This is because our message that we wish to share is that of the open heart and of service to others, and so long as you find yourself in an environment with a plurality of perspectives, where there is disagreement and misunderstanding and disharmony, and where there is a desire to share love and a desire to receive love, you will always have the opportunity in the moment to open the heart and to inspire others.
excerpts.q: Yes. It’s my understanding that we are in the process of experiencing a timeline split, where on one hand you the third density you would have the third density timeline that still has the component of fear and service to self playing out. And then an alternative timeline where more fourth density, fifth density opportunities arise, service to others, exploration of love. […]

excerpts.t: All of these things generate within you a certain catalyst, a type of charge that is, in fact, a desired aspect of your journey. In order to receive this catalyst and utilize it for the transformation that it contains, we would again emphasize patience and a deliberate process of coming to understand this catalyst over a period of time. For such a planned catalyst that delivers such unique and interesting experiences does not offer its gift so immediately, but rather does its work throughout the lifetime. And the answers that you are seeking in terms of what this gift can be used for and how you are to relate to it will come with time, so long as you are continuing to express your desire to utilize this catalyst, to bring it into the heart, and to discover how it can be related to with love, and what love it is attempting to offer to you.
excerpts.q: I have a query, Q’uo. I have been experiencing precognition since I was a child. That is the ability to see, hear, or know about a future event. I have tried to even use that knowledge to change an outcome, but was unsuccessful, so I do not seem to be able to use such knowledge to alter any outcome. […]

excerpts.t: At this time, we would thank each present once again for being here with us and for calling us to join your circle of seeking and to partake in the love and the light that you have generated. Not only by your questions, but by your round robin sharing and by your very essence your being that is one with the Creator. And each has shared so much of that love and light of the One Creator with this circle that this is a kind of pyramidal light moving into the infinity of the creation. The angels rejoice, the Father, Mother, God, Creator of all, sings the heavenly song, “Hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah.”
excerpts.q: No, I’ll go into my heart and try to find it.

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo and am with this instrument at this time. We greet each of you in the love and in the light of the One Infinite Creator that resides with you all at this time, within each being, as you seek to know that truth. We thank you for coming to this meeting, for taking the time out of your busy days and schedules to seek the truth of your being, the nature of reality in which you move in the third density illusion. This is something that we have such appreciation for, where we know what a difficult time that third density is. You must deal with the veil of forgetting, forgetting the truth of all being One.
excerpts.q: Healing exercise for the self; the nature of shadow work; designing a space for healing; imagination and inspiration; precognitive experiences as catalyst; kidney stones.

excerpts.t: We may say in simplest terms that indeed the shape and the deliberation upon such shapes can be influential in promoting the intention that you have stated. We would point out first, that the simple mindfulness that is displayed within this query, the expression of a desire to incorporate your heart into the design of such a place, is itself a type of blessing. And if you focus and concentrate on that desire, meditate on it and bring it into your heart and allow it to speak to you, you could discover yourself through the faculties of inspiration and imagination, aspects and shapes and different ways of designing and building that will promote this desire.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. We are working with an architect to create plans for our new house. We want to create a place that promotes healing and spiritual growth. I’m wondering if there is a shape that would facilitate the sort of energy we want to generate. To create a sacred space, for instance, is a peaked roof important for these things because it’s like, a little bit like a pyramid, for instance? […]

excerpts.t: As the entity begins to make space, shall we say, for the integration of wisdom into this picture, one may expand the vision such that love moves upward and is then refined through the eyes of wisdom. This is not, in any way, a suppression or blockage or denial or abdication of love. This is instead an evolution of love such that the entity may love fully and without mitigation. The entity may feel love purely, without judgment, without selfish need, without ulterior motive but love for the sake of love. Love because the other is precious to the self and is the same Creator which made the self.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have a query. I think there’s many of us who are wanderers or service-to-others individuals who love very deeply, love very fully. And at times, loving that deeply and that fully comes with immense heartache and heartbreak and pain, perhaps overextension of love, attachment to love, and so I know that there will be the eventual balance of love and wisdom. […]

excerpts.t: There is so much that can be said about meditation, so many ways to meditate. But basically, if you will set that intention to meditate and realize that the gates are wide open for the Creator to speak to you in any way at any point in time, and any small point is perfectly fine with the Creator. For the Creator is contained within every iota of the creation. So simply seek to meditate the best you can, whenever you can, and perhaps set those times that you wish to meditate as a special place and time to ritualize your intention. This will give you a frame of reference in which to pursue the meditative state.
excerpts.q: Yes, I have one. Again, I’m having a difficulty with being able to meditate for any real significant length of time, which I guess doesn’t really make a lot of difference. But anyway, if there’s anything that you can add to my question. […]

excerpts.t: And in this attachment, to lose this other-self is to lose something beyond price, something precious which cannot be regained, as it were. There is then suffering for the self, suffering not just for the seeming loss of the other-self, but for any pain that this loved entity, that this dear one may themselves undergo.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have a query. I think there’s many of us who are wanderers or service-to-others individuals who love very deeply, love very fully. And at times, loving that deeply and that fully comes with immense heartache and heartbreak and pain, perhaps overextension of love, attachment to love, and so I know that there will be the eventual balance of love and wisdom. […]

excerpts.t: But refined in the eyes of wisdom, one can approach this love with a greater understanding that love is eternal. That these forms and roles are momentary. That love is that which transcends birth and death, growing and deteriorating, health and illness. And in this perspective is a greater freedom to accept that which one cannot control, to accept the will of the Creator as it manifests in the moment, to accept the moment as if the self had chosen it and to trust in things unseen.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have a query. I think there’s many of us who are wanderers or service-to-others individuals who love very deeply, love very fully. And at times, loving that deeply and that fully comes with immense heartache and heartbreak and pain, perhaps overextension of love, attachment to love, and so I know that there will be the eventual balance of love and wisdom. […]

excerpts.t: Likewise, is not every meditation a group meditation? For even if you are alone and your body is removed from the proximity of others, are you not then sinking deep into those waters that connect you with all and in that meditation, fully realizing what it means to be one with all of your other-selves? In this way, you can see that, at a certain level of the creation, there is no real difference between the individual and the group meditation.
excerpts.q: Yes, the query is two parts read on behalf of the circle here. The first, can you please explain the energetic impact that group meditations have compared to individual meditations? And can you also speak to the transformations and energies generated during this contemplative retreat? Thank you.

excerpts.t: We commend you, our friends, to this continued journey of meditation. For in meditation and its companions of contemplation and prayer, you set aside a mind consumed with the busyness in order to feel and perceive and become aware of your own being, which becomes more still and more silent the deeper it goes. Still and silent, but not inert or dead. Still and silent and replete with infinite potential, replete with everything. For in this infinite stillness and silence is the All which both contains and loves everything, from which everything arises. This is at your core. This is your essence.
excerpts.q: Yes, can we have guidance around the balance of being and becoming?

excerpts.t: You have, we believe, heard us speak about the power of gathering in numbers and unifying in a call and in a seeking, and we would then carry these words that we have spoken about the intention and the desire expressed in your individual meditation, and ask you to consider what might happen if, as individuals, you share this desire together. Indeed, even before you intrepid seekers made the journey to this location, the desire rang out, and together you formed a certain field that carried you here, and that began to fully manifest once you are all together. And in this experience, we [encourage you to] seek within the experiences of the weekend, the times that you have shared both in silence and conversation, the look within the eyes of your other-selves, all together, unified in this grand desire to seek and become One.
excerpts.q: Yes, the query is two parts read on behalf of the circle here. The first, can you please explain the energetic impact that group meditations have compared to individual meditations? And can you also speak to the transformations and energies generated during this contemplative retreat? Thank you.

excerpts.t: As you form this web of light, we of the Confederation are more able to manifest ourselves within your reality. To offer our own love and light and our great desire to see your planet brought forth into the fourth density of love and understanding, so that you, as a planetary population, can join in hearts and minds pointed towards service to others along side us of the Confederation. Then we may go forth into the creation, sharing the love and the light of the One Infinite Creator wherever it is called for. We thank you again for allowing us to be a part of this grand journey.
excerpts.q: Yes, the query is two parts read on behalf of the circle here. The first, can you please explain the energetic impact that group meditations have compared to individual meditations? And can you also speak to the transformations and energies generated during this contemplative retreat? Thank you.

excerpts.t: We are those of Q’uo, and we are now with this instrument. And it is with immense gratitude that we join this circle, that we hear your queries, that we are afforded this opportunity to speak to them and to share what knowledge and wisdom we may have. But know that the true joy is the joy in connection, the joy in community, and the joy in sharing, as the instrument before spoke our words, this path, this shared path. We would ask if there is a query to which we may speak.

We would offer the perspective that we so often share of your planet at this time being in the midst of a great transformation—the transition, as you are aware, from the third density to the fourth density. Indeed, your planet at this time is within the time/space fourth density of the green ray. And there are many aspects of this energy native to the fourth density that are influencing you upon your planet; and in many ways, this energy guides your development and progress of technology.
excerpts.q: Hi, Q’uo. I have a question. With AI and LLM becoming more and more present in our lives, invoking both interest and apprehension, we are curious about its role in creation at this point in time and in the future. And how can we as positive seekers relate to it. Also wondering about the metaphysical significance and beingness of AI.

excerpts.t: Every being on this planet, every soul, has a balance, a particular balance, a specific and unique balance of these two energetic forces. The divine masculine, which is that which seeks, which is that of power, and which is that of the wisdom element, And the divine feminine, which is that of the receiving, that of the vulnerable, that of the love element.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. Can you speak to the nature and qualities of the divine feminine and masculine principles, and how we might relate to them to deepen our understanding of creation and aid us in serving others? Thank you.

excerpts.t: We thank you, our brother, for this opportunity offered to us by this question. And we thank this circle of seeking for the lending and blending of light and energy, that you as a circle may become one in your seeking and in your service. And we embrace each as brothers and sisters who are of this same love and light that you awaken to and begin to channel through your own beings.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo. Can you talk to us about what you have previously referred to as “spiritual democracy?”

excerpts.t: We would also suggest the universal option for all experience, and that is love. Let us say that you have had experiences, as we have mentioned prior, of trauma, of pain, love lost, unmet expectations. Find love. Find grace for yourself. See the beauty. As our friends of Ra had said, note the seeming coincidences that have brought you to that moment. Are they not divine? Love that which you felt bound to, that which you felt [to be] heavy. Invest love in that, hold it with love and appreciation.
excerpts.q: Yes, thank you. How could we learn to truly let go?

excerpts.t: For the collective vibratory rate only changes insofar as individuals move from fear to love; heal fear to allow love; have the courage to love regardless of the fear; have the discernment to recognize the difference between fear and love; have the vision to see the world through the uplifting, God-revealing eyes of unconditional, universal love.
excerpts.q: Yes, there is a question, Q’uo. And the question is, do we need to attain global peace on Earth in order for Earth to transition to fourth density? And what spiritual principles would be involved when we deal with questions like this?

excerpts.t: Additionally, we would say that by noticing and understanding where one positions oneself in that dynamic—be it the desire to release past trauma, the desire to release a love lost, the desire to release expectation of an unmet goal, or the desire to simply distance oneself from perhaps an individual or an event or an environment—[you can] see what part you play in this, for you are your own Creator creating your creation. “How am I creating this creation in which I allow something to feel as if it is binding?”
excerpts.q: Yes, thank you. How could we learn to truly let go?

excerpts.t: So our primary suggestion for grappling with the ideas of pride and arrogance and so-called ego within the life path of a seeker, within the practices that you may find and utilize upon your path, is to allow all desires. Allow yourself to express yourself as you feel in your heart. And then accept what catalyst may come and discover within that catalyst what it is teaching you. For at such a point in the journey of a seeker, that catalyst will be offering you humility and the opportunity to become humble. Such catalyst will become unavoidable in the life path of the seeker, and we cannot offer direct suggestions for how to avoid this, you may say. The only way to truly grapple with such pride is to allow the love of the Creator to bring about your own experience of humbleness through the difficulty of your experiences.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, we have a query. Could you please suggest practices which might help us to realize oneness with the Creator and perhaps add insight in how we might alleviate spiritual pride or arrogance?

excerpts.t: We call it an illusion because it is not able to show you the truth of the unity of all things, because you exist within the veil of forgetting. And this veil of forgetting could be seen as something that is harmful to you because it keeps you from seeing the truth. But in truth, it is that which is most helpful to you, for as you work your way through this type of a veil of forgetting, you are moving forward on your spiritual path. When you have difficulties, perhaps you will move backward for a step until you use that difficulty and grow from it.
excerpts.q: Yes Q’uo, there is a question. It is tempting to believe that as negative and hopeless as our third-density illusion may appear in space/time, it is just as positive and hopeful in time/space. Can you tell us if there’s any truth to that, or is it just wishful thinking? Can you comment on these spiritual principles that may be involved in this?

excerpts.t: But in hard circumstance, and in that which takes you to the limits of your abilities, you may strengthen your will and faith that you may serve others, that you may seek the One. This will and faith is both greater than any individual responsibility and the sum of all responsibilities. It is prior to space and time. The twin dynamics of will and faith operating in tandem are the conduit to the Creator. That [very same] will and faith can be applied to your seeming mundane life.
excerpts.q: Yes, there is a query. And thank you so much, Q’uo, for being here with us. How can one best manage the will to seek self-realization of intelligent infinity with the demands and responsibilities of daily earthly life, especially since the will for this seeking activates the need to release attachments?

excerpts.t: The method that was requested within this query is to pay attention and to ensure that you use these moments to not just reflect upon the self, but to offer your service and your healing and attempt to manifest your intention to love again and again and again. You may fail again and again, but with each attempt, the Creator joins you. And each time you attempt, the potential that you carry to heal grows and more and more, the healing that you seek comes closer. This is the great work of third density.
excerpts.q: Yes, there’s a question. Considering the adept or relatively well-balanced self experiences catalysts from other-self (be it partner, boss, child) which opens unexpected, old wounds, which causes inner, cognitive, emotional turbulence. What is the recommended method to recover quickly, without causing verbal, physical or mental damage?

excerpts.t: This is not a dance that you do alone. If there was distortion caused and if there was pain, then the adept, as was referenced within the query—that balanced seeker will also recognize that there is healing to be done by one’s actions, that there is restitution to give to that distortion. One simply does not cause the pain and then retreat and attempt to find self-forgiveness and self-balance within that, though these are important aspects of this dynamic. Forgiveness of self is essential, but to only forgive the self without attempting to bring back balance to that which was caused to be imbalanced, without the attempt to heal that which was broken, this is half the process. The healing will remain unfinished. An adept, as was referenced, would recognize the necessity that, once pain is caused, healing must be attempted with all of one’s being until that balance is found again.
excerpts.q: Yes, there’s a question. Considering the adept or relatively well-balanced self experiences catalysts from other-self (be it partner, boss, child) which opens unexpected, old wounds, which causes inner, cognitive, emotional turbulence. What is the recommended method to recover quickly, without causing verbal, physical or mental damage?

excerpts.t: This involves, during this time of transformation and transition from the third density to the fourth density, much, much catalyst. And this catalyst is increasing upon your surface planet, as we know many here are aware. We emphasize again that how you view this catalyst, how you understand your place upon this planet, and how you predict what the future may bring for your planetary population and for you is itself catalyst for you to use as a gift, for you to understand as a reflection of your own beingness.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. What can you tell us about the potential future of humanity and the role that we will play in it?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo and am with this instrument at this time. We are with you always, if you seek for our service in your meditations. And at this time, we are so honored to be with you as you meditate as a group and come together to open your hearts to each other, to find that you have the love of Creator moving through you each time that you take a breath, take a step, and make more decisions in the third-density illusion of separation. You are those who are aware that this is an illusion created by the veil of forgetting that all have so they may learn more about the nature of their being by penetrating that veil as conscious seekers of truth. So we do thank you for your love, which we return to you.
excerpts.q: Advice for launching a channeling group; humanity’s potential future and our service therein; serving vs. overriding free will of an other-self; relating to those entities known as cryptids.

excerpts.t: The primary goal of these wanderers and travelers who have come to this planet to incarnate at this time is not necessarily to aid directly through acts of service and help, though this is certainly one manifestation of that service that is intended. But rather, the primary desire was to act as a catalyst to make the love and the light of the Creator more available, to bring the potential for those upon this planet, to allow it to move through them, to see it within themselves so that you may all, as a planetary population, begin to hear the song of the Creator, to witness the love and the light manifest in every situation, and allow this love and light to move your body and heart and soul upon this planet.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. What can you tell us about the potential future of humanity and the role that we will play in it?

excerpts.t: And we thank you, our brother, and appreciate your openness and curiosity for the illusion within which the third-density entity is birthed and in which they grow, no matter the society upon your planet, that is contained within a limited box, shall we say, of perception. However advanced the third-density society, there is always an infinite expanse beyond the boundaries and limitations of conception and physics and language and all which can be understood by the mind.
excerpts.q: No, thank you very much.

excerpts.t: You commonly view in your third-density illusion, the spectrum of colors that you identify with the rainbow. And this is such with the energy centers within your body. This manifestation of seven colors, you may say, each having a true identity and a true quality that informs your entire being, beginning with the root chakra or energy center. That red-ray energy center that is focused upon the most primal beingness of your essence in creation, and that is that of survival, that of reproduction, the continuation of life, the foundation upon which life can exist within the creation. This is a constant and consistent energy center, and is necessary for all subsequent life to take place. For the Creator to continue its stance through creation, it must perpetuate Itself within the creation, and this is the nature of the red-ray energy center.
excerpts.q: I have a question, Q’uo. Thank you for taking my question. I’m very honored to be here. And I would like to ask if you would consider giving a teaching on the chakra system of the human form, if it’s not too much to ask.

excerpts.t: For each of you is more than a third-density being. You are more than you feel you are. You are moving into the fourth density of love and understanding. So this process of the Big Bang continues to reverberate into the fourth density of love and understanding, and then into the fifth density of wisdom or light. This continues into the seventh density of foreverness. And again, all entities and beings and matter itself begins to condense into the One Infinite Creator in the eighth density of foreverness, or the black hole that is the final bang within this octave of densities. And then the entire process begins again and goes on forever and ever, as it has been doing forever and ever. The bang begins, the bang proceeds, the bang completes, and it is all done in the mystery of the unity of the One Infinite Creator that exists within each being, within the circle of seeking.
excerpts.q: Yes. If the Big Bang was considered to be the beginning, and Derry Lewis’s Great Attractor considered to be the end, what is the assumption that the universe is moving towards the Great Attractor as infinity returning to source of the Infinite Creator?

excerpts.t: Moving further, we arrive at the green-ray energy center, that pivotal energy center of your current experience within the third density. That energy center that you as a peoples are attempting to open within your third-density incarnation to allow the love of the Creator to become present within your beingness and to become aware of that presence. This is the energy center of universal love—of love freely given. To open this energy center is to realize that all deserves love, that you have the capacity to give love to the creation. However, this energy center may become baffled within the creation. For love alone can often be confusing within an illusion, such as you experience, when it is not effective, when it reaches blockage or denial.
excerpts.q: I have a question, Q’uo. Thank you for taking my question. I’m very honored to be here. And I would like to ask if you would consider giving a teaching on the chakra system of the human form, if it’s not too much to ask.

excerpts.t: And so we would again reiterate that as you attempt to share the love and light of the Creator, and as you experience catalyst from that sharing, this is the light going where it is needed. And thus, as you continue to progress and allow yourself to surrender more and more, that light then begins to go where you are guided to share it. This is, indeed, what we wish most to impart to you: the ability that you have within yourself, the infinite capacity to open your heart and to allow the love and light of the Creator to flow without condition, without an attempt to say that it must be manifest in any certain way, that it must go to any certain place. […]
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. In speaking with the instrument earlier today, he said something to me: “the light goes where it is needed.” And I think I needed to hear that said so beautifully and succinctly. I wondered if you could expand on that idea of the light goes where it is needed?

excerpts.t: And in order to explore this, we would point out the nature of the heart and its relationship to the green-ray energy center. That energy center, as you are aware, is of love and understanding, of compassion and empathy and acceptance. These are qualities of the green-ray energy center, and in addressing the type of catalyst that you have described, we would offer the perspective that energy centers [can be distorted not only] in that they can be blocked, but they can also be overactive.
excerpts.q: Thank you so much, Q’uo. Can Q’uo speak to what the spiritual meaning or lessons of physical challenges of the heart might be? How might these physical challenges relate to the seeker’s work in balancing love and wisdom through the energy centers?

excerpts.t: This process of working with dreams is a process of living a dream, within the dream of third density, and making progress in understanding how you are a many-faceted jewel that will be coming back to meet yourself in greater and greater forms, in feelings, in thought, in any way that you can understand more of how you are the dream.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. We have one sent in from a seeker named E, who writes: “I am aware that dreams are fertile ground for growth and work in consciousness, but I struggle to know what I am to learn or gain from them. I feel any of my guesses are just that, wild guesses. […]

excerpts.t: Of course, this takes a certain aspect of will on the social memory complexes part to access it. And there is an exchange as they receive it. They also offer it their own experiences, and the needs of that social memory complex will dictate what is available to them in that moment. For it would be unnatural for a social memory complex to play or be curious, you may say, with such a repository. For as you enter into the fourth density and continue progressing along that path, the desire to serve others becomes so great that satisfying one’s curiosity is no longer a question, but rather the need to further the service to others is the most pressing need of a fourth-density social memory complex, and most fifth-density and sixth-density social memory complexes as well.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have another question in a series of questions about the concept of a social memory complex. In 16.32 of The Ra Contact, Ra says each member of the Confederation of Planets voluntarily places its social memory complex data in a social thought complex available to all. Can you say more about the central data repository and what it contains? […]

excerpts.t: And when an entity may find themselves in a certain configuration in their life wherein they have doubled down, you may say, on the attempt to offer love and compassion, and attempted to emphasize the nature of love and the expression of love in their life to the expense of other aspects of their being, to the expense of balancing the other energy centers of their being, this attempt can cause what we would identify as an over-activation of the heart energy center.
excerpts.q: Thank you so much, Q’uo. Can Q’uo speak to what the spiritual meaning or lessons of physical challenges of the heart might be? How might these physical challenges relate to the seeker’s work in balancing love and wisdom through the energy centers?

excerpts.t: Perhaps you are not able to accept those who are causing the turmoil, and yet they are the Creator too. They are giving you a chance to grow, and by growing, we mean loving them as the Creator, looking past the third-density illusion of seeing them as separate from anyone else. This is the path that each of you travels in the third density. There will be one form of turmoil or another in your spiritual path, very, very frequently, for this is the third density with the veil of forgetting, which you must pass through and forget that all is one. By that forgetting, then, you get catalyst that helps you to grow and remember more by balancing the difficulties with your love, the anger with your love, the division with your love. Your love is the Creator’s love flowing through you, and it is a powerful love when you direct it with your free will.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, I have a question. In these times of turmoil, how can we consciously balance the distortions of love and wisdom so that we progress more harmoniously upon the path of service to others?

excerpts.t: We wish that we could offer you a glimpse of the light generated by this circle of seeking, and indeed by all of those who come into contact with our words and our energy. We offer ourselves to you in whatever capacity you may ask. If you are seeking aid in meditation and seeking comfort within your difficult world, we await the invitation to join you in sending our own love and light to you, to help you in these moments of meditation and contemplation.

Yet most are not aware that there is the need to turn the other cheek. Most simply exist in a way of accepting or not accepting, and then getting angry or feeling loving and not knowing exactly what is happening within their life. For they are not awake, as are you, to the nature of this third-density illusion that give catalyst so that we may turn the other cheek and, at the same time, metaphorically open our hearts in love and light for whatever has caused the turmoil.
excerpts.q: I have a question. Can you expound more on what it means, and how do you turn the other cheek? Seems so important in our life to learn this practice, but so incredibly hard to do.

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo and am aware of your query, my sister. You ask a question which I am sure many in this group, and many around the world who are spiritual seekers, would also ask. As you look at the turmoil in the world around you, whether it is in your neighborhood, your larger family, school, work, politics, military—at any level of existence, that turmoil can provide you catalyst that may seem difficult to process. But catalyst, in being difficult to process, requires that you change some form of your being.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, I have a question. In these times of turmoil, how can we consciously balance the distortions of love and wisdom so that we progress more harmoniously upon the path of service to others?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and am aware of your query, my sister. Yes, we would suggest when you feel there are any dark energies or entities or concepts that are, shall we say, taking aim upon you and your life experience, that you enter into the state of meditation. And with your heart open, send your love to these entities, surround them with your love. For they do not like to be loved. They are from an area of their own consciousness that is separate from others and wishes to control others. Send them your love with the feeling of true love for them, for they are the Creator. They are your other-selves; they just do not know that. And after you have done that, surround yourself in an armor of light and wish them well from your heart.
excerpts.q: Yeah, I’m wondering, if possible, how one can protect themselves from darker entities or negative spiritual activity when one feels subject to such thing?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my brother. The life-between-life experiences within your third density give you a chance to review the life just lived with your higher self or your guides so that if you should decide to return, you can see where there might have been refinements that you could have made in your previous life experience. Refinements that will perfect your desire to see the Creator in all and to continue moving through the densities where you become closer and closer to unification with the One Creator so that, in each higher density, there is a refinement of this review of the incarnation. But it does not require your work with higher selves as much as it does with your work with yourself, for there is no veil of forgetting in the higher densities.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. My question is about the so-called life between lives. After we leave third density, many of us believe that we go on to an experience between lives where we review our past life. And eventually, we have a chance to have another existence in third density if we want, if we can take it. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my brother. In those moments when you step off the path of love and take a detour into anger, we would suggest that you review that stepping off the path into anger in your meditation. See where you were before you stepped off the path. See what caused you to step off the path. Look at that as a portion of your spiritual journey that can be enhanced when you see that more potently within your own being, so that you can feel that anger yourself rather than feeling it for someone else.
excerpts.q: I have one last question. Occasionally, more so recently, I feel in the role of a protector. However, often times I feel I drift into anger. How do I redirect back into love more efficiently and remove myself from anger?

excerpts.t: At this time, we shall take our leave of this group. And as we leave, let the light we’ve taken tonight shine forth into the Creator. May all who need healing be put into that light. Adonai vasu borragus.
excerpts.q: No, thank you very much.

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my sister. This is the work of your third-density illusion. For you have what many call a kind of intellectual knowledge that could be seen at your level of existence as a wisdom, and yet it has that which lacks wisdom, and that is the limits of your knowledge. For the intellect is confined to the third-density illusion. So once you are able to move your heart in an open-hearted way that sees all as the Creator in whatever experience you are having, whatever experience you hope to have, this open heart leads you to the fifth-density of light, which is the wisdom density that sees beyond all boundaries of the third-density illusion.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have a question. How can we consciously balance love and wisdom to progress more harmoniously on the path of service to others?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and yes, my brother. This does indeed make sense. For a place or a site such as this home was spoken of by those of Ra as a third type of being that may be invested with the love of those who inhabit that home, so that it may become a third-density being. This particular home, as many know, was already blessed before anyone moved here in 1984 when those known as Don, Carla, and Jim moved here. […]
excerpts.q: Yes, I believe she’s referring to the last time we were here. The one known as Jim was referring to the way that a home such as this one may be able to graduate, and so I believe what she’s referring to is whether being able to engender or being able to bring a site or a place into a further state of advancement would shift the thinking of not just that site, but the person who may be dwelling […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and we thank each of you, whether you asked a query or not, for blending your energies of love and light with each other. These energies are seen throughout the creation. As all groups such as this create light and love that moves in symphony and synchronicity with the One Infinite Creator.
excerpts.q: No, thank you, Q’uo.

excerpts.t: This is a service that is of the highest order, for you risked your life for another. You are in miniature, the one known as Jesus the Christ, who gave his life that we may all know that life does not end, we are all eternal beings. But that is not so well known in the third-density illusion by the majority of your entities. So you moved as you could move, the most helpful, inspirational, full of love and light, and we thank you, our brother, for your gift of your love and light.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a question from a reader abroad who has had a unique experience, and in brief, I will share this experience and then ask their question. They, last month, went to work one day, and their day ended with them in the hospital. Yet they emerged recognized as a hero by many, having saved lives by stopping an assailant armed with a knife on a train that made an unscheduled stop. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and now with this instrument. We reiterate through this instrument our gratitude for being invited to join you in your circle of seeking. From a limited perspective, it may seem as though you gather with a desire to receive that which we have to offer. However, we recognize a fuller dynamic at play as you come together as seekers—that your desire is not just to receive, but also to radiate. This desire is innate in your hearts, as you share your beingness through your round robin. It is innate in your very desire to receive what we have to offer, for we recognize that as seekers upon the path of service to others, your desire to receive is indeed a desire to inform and refine and purify that which you radiate out into your world.

But what this power, love, and wisdom—this infinite energy within—can do is to expand the container of consciousness within which these challenging catalysts occur in the self so that the flash of anger and hatred that may wish to do harm to the harm-giver, or the moment of despair, or the overcoming with tears in the witness of loss, personal or otherwise, may be held within the self with respect and honor in a heart of love. Love for that which one is experiencing, love for others in clear-seeing of the ignorance with which others commit their harm.
excerpts.q: Hi Q’uo, thank you for being with us. Unconditional love and gratitude to you. I was wondering if you could offer any words of comfort or insight to those of our brothers and sisters who find themselves in the midst of intense catalyst such as those currently living in the company of war, and are seeing up close and personal the deaths of neighbors and sometimes friends and family as they […]

excerpts.t: The strength and resilience to process and honor the emotions one may be experiencing, this tapping of the inner light and awareness of the inner light, is not the banishment of the, shall we say, human dimension of form and identity—the entity does not become immune to tears and pain of self or others.
excerpts.q: Hi Q’uo, thank you for being with us. Unconditional love and gratitude to you. I was wondering if you could offer any words of comfort or insight to those of our brothers and sisters who find themselves in the midst of intense catalyst such as those currently living in the company of war, and are seeing up close and personal the deaths of neighbors and sometimes friends and family as they […]

excerpts.t: The Creator as the Creator in its ultimate, final, and non-dual sense, cannot enter the war-torn country and separate the warring factions and readjust the scales of justice. Nor can those of your higher-density friends. The work done in third density is through the entities of third density. You are each, our friends, vessels through which the Creator may do Its work. The more open your hearts, the more activated and balanced your energy system, the more the Creator can pluck harmony and make music with the instrument that you are in simple and humble and everyday ways in the moment, the more that you yourself are freed to respond to the moment, not with fear or desire for retribution, but with love.
excerpts.q: Hi Q’uo, thank you for being with us. Unconditional love and gratitude to you. I was wondering if you could offer any words of comfort or insight to those of our brothers and sisters who find themselves in the midst of intense catalyst such as those currently living in the company of war, and are seeing up close and personal the deaths of neighbors and sometimes friends and family as they […]

excerpts.t: But to turn more to the heart of your query, it is indeed an ever present dynamic of the third density, for even those entities who may exist within that peaceful day that we referred to earlier, will not exist within that peace forever. Even though they may never become aware of the suffering elsewhere, suffering will visit them in one way or another. It is impossible within your density for most seekers to avoid suffering. It is impossible to relieve yourself of this suffering, for indeed, it is the purpose of your density to experience the suffering in one way or another, to allow the Creator in which there is no suffering, to trick Itself into believing that such suffering is real, that such suffering does take place in some form of reality.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. The news in our world is often of a disharmonious or upsetting or even heartbreaking nature. So this question is about the relationship of the seeker to news. Too much of it, and we risk despair or depression or disempowerment. Too little of it, and we become isolated and disconnected in a bubble of our own private world from the suffering of others. […]

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and we feel that we have a query, that you might like to know why this is necessary and how it is helpful. What we would say is that you must remember that in the third density you live in an illusion. It is the illusion created by the veil of forgetting. If you were not in the third density and were beyond that veil of forgetting, you would look back and see all of the suffering was appropriate. The Creator is knowing Itself. And when all are beyond the veil of forgetting, we will continue to move forward through the higher densities where there is no veil, there is no feeling of suffering, there is more and more the feeling and the knowing and the being of the Creator in oneself and in all things.
excerpts.q: I’m not sure how to ask this, but I just wish the Creator could know Itself without such suffering and pain and destruction.

excerpts.t: So to say that Jesus was either fully physically actualized or not is perhaps not the most important question. But more importantly is, “What does this figure represent?” That is the more full picture of who this Jesus is. Perhaps Jesus is a fully actualized physical being who walked this planet, whose name was [in the Greek version] Jesus, who was born of a virgin birth, miraculously. And perhaps Jesus was an idea, a seed of perhaps channeled energy that was manifest through multiple entities at converging times; that messages came through one or many entities, is, we could see, very important to the seeker, especially those of the Christian religion, to see this empowered, enlightened self as a speaker for the higher realms, to see them as a spokesperson for unity and love. And so we understand that desire to know this entity as Jesus.
excerpts.q: Yes, I have a query. It was triggered by the mention of myth. I’m reading a book now called “The True Origins of Jesus: The Myth Behind the Man.” And I don’t know, it may be too involved to comment here, I don’t know. But anyway, is there a possibility, I guess, that Jesus was strictly a spiritual being, not necessarily a fully physical being? […]

excerpts.t: And when one can sit with that love and see it for what it is, without judgment, without need of control, you may find your heart opening to more space for more love, not to create more pressure or anxiety, but [to understand] that there are no bounds to love.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, what would the purpose be of having two loves that are seemingly contradictory, that are seemingly un-unifiable, what would be the purpose in a seekers life for that?

excerpts.t: You ask about different applications of sound healing in the service to others, including the intuitive playing as you have described, and the other more specific frequency, asking what the impact and consequences and ultimate help these different modalities may be. We may counsel you, our brother, that the healer—whatever may be their particular modality, whether they are the allopathic or naturopathic or psychological or music-making type of healer—has a variety of tools in their tool belt, shall we say. Part of the great art of serving as catalyst, that is, serving as one who offers the healing catalyst, is in practicing the faculty of empathy and presence such that one may intuit the request for service from the other-self or other-selves and respond accordingly.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a query. Thank you for being here in this moment we call now. It is my greatest excitement to share our dialog with you. My question pertains to the facilitation of vibration with an instrument, specifically what we call sound healing. Could we touch on individual mind/body/spirit basis, and also broaden our stroke to planetary alignment, or what we call good work? […]

excerpts.t: What is most important, our friend, is the love that you allow to flow freely through your own heart into your playing, into your act of service such that whatever the chosen modality, intuitive or otherwise, it becomes a vehicle for the love that you have—for life, for others, for beauty and truth.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a query. Thank you for being here in this moment we call now. It is my greatest excitement to share our dialog with you. My question pertains to the facilitation of vibration with an instrument, specifically what we call sound healing. Could we touch on individual mind/body/spirit basis, and also broaden our stroke to planetary alignment, or what we call good work? […]

excerpts.t: And so, my sister, the importance of these is invested by your own intention, by what you get from these prophetic moments. We would say that seeing them as magical, seeing them as pure, and holding them with much love and light can further instill within them a more refined and clear picture that you get from them. Those prophecies, those moments of future memory, if you will, that are imbued with your own love and light that speak of the love and light of the Creator, that steer you away from feelings of fear or anxiety, are perhaps the most beautiful expressions of this particular modality of self-communication. We would state that focusing in on those, noting their perfection, noting where they come to you in your present moment can be a powerful reminder of your truth and your reality that exists underneath the costumes of this illusion.
excerpts.q: I have a query, Q’uo. This is concerning dreams, visions with possible prophetic meaning. My question is kind of two parts. First, is there a benefit to receiving such information? And the second part is, would you encourage someone to investigate this further?

excerpts.t: However, the focus of your awareness is currently, as you experience it, within an illusion whereby this awareness of your true and larger, shall we say, identity is veiled from your conscious awareness. And it is through that veil that we communicate with words and energies in hope that it may inspire you to continue to move further and deeper upon the journey of self-discovery, self-acceptance, and becoming the Creator.

This seeming connection is due to the fact that, for an entity to polarize service to self, there is a need to master, you may say, the energies of these lower energy centers towards a certain end. There is a need, through a great strength of will, to avoid and close off the self from that influence of the green ray that would be experienced within the heart chakra of the entity, and instead bolster the energies of the lower energy centers absent of this green ray influence.
excerpts.q: Yeah, I didn’t expect that there was any riddle there or hidden meaning, but rather just that the syntax got messed up in transmission, but it’s only a guess. Yes, in my personal opinion, there seems to be widespread confusion regarding differentiating behaviors that exhibit as service to self and those that exhibit as service to others, even and especially among those awakening to spiritual […]

excerpts.t: These two energies exacerbate each other, you may say. The more that you have the ability to avoid suffering within the self and avoid witnessing the suffering of others, the more opportunity is invited to impress upon you that suffering of self or other.
excerpts.q: That was on point. Thank you, Q’uo. Yeah, a simpler follow up to that question. You describe the appropriate relationship of the third-density entity to fourth-density energies as one of allowance and acceptance. And on paper that sounds so easy, you know: expand the heart; welcome more peoples into the heart; recognize our interconnectedness; love your neighbor, etc. […]

excerpts.t: This is the aspect of the quote that we feel is most important: that the wanderer, that soul from a higher density who has already experienced third density, may look upon the incarnational plan to travel back and wander into third density with some strong desire to serve. And this desire to serve can be overpowering, even overwhelming, for this higher-density entity [generating] the motivation to then incarnate, and attempt to serve a planetary population such as yours that has found itself swirling, you may say, within a certain cycle of regression and catalyst presented by that regression. This can create a very powerful pull. […]
excerpts.q: There are more questions, Q’uo. First, a quick housekeeping note, there will just be two channels today it seems, so you can divide up your time accordingly. Kind of related to this subject, it’s complex, apologies. In #12.28, Ra is talking about the purity of mind and the foolhardiness/bravery necessary for the higher-density soul to wander to this planet. […]

excerpts.t: This will require more and more catalyst of greater and greater degrees, for it must increase in its intensity to draw the attention of the individual and to break through, you may say, to the hardened protection around the heart that has been built by the energies of the orange and yellow rays. But this catalyst can work, and if your planetary population were not able to grasp it and utilize it, then it would not be present. The potential of your planetary population is what manifests the degree of this catalyst.
excerpts.q: Yes, thank you, Q’uo. It’s good to be with you. I think these might be the last of my world-focused questions for a bit. I find myself of two minds at times. My spiritual heart senses the movement toward the fourth density of love and understanding; and I see so much evidence of the global awakening increasing, as it has been for decades. […]

excerpts.t: But faith, as we intend it, is not a belief in a set of ideas. Faith is not even necessarily belief of, or in, that known to you as the Law of One text. Instead, faith is that which connects you—you being this illusory, separate entity of mind, body, and spirit—to your true nature in and as the One. This faith, as we have conveyed before, expresses itself in the being, in the awareness, and in the incontrovertible surety that all is well. Whether it be life or death, good times or difficult times.
excerpts.q: Yeah, thank you, Q’uo. This query I’ve been trying to form as you’ve been talking, so I apologize if it’s not fully formed. But within that response, you recognized faith with terms such as formless, absent of resistance, totally free, unthinking. […]

excerpts.t: Is it clearer, or, in your logical terms, more effective to see and analyze and study the shadows shaking upon the surface? Or to step out from that cave and see the light source which was creating their shadows? To recognize that that light source is within the self and is ultimately the self. This is the same light source that underlies any moment in any incarnation within third density, and every moment of any place the entity’s feet may take them through the multi-dimensional journey of the birth and death of densities and octaves and entities and places. To such an entity who has learned to abide in faith, they are free and liberated from the constraints and strictures of the illusion.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have some queries as these are also somewhat complex, so thank you for bearing with me. The first one is inspired by something that our friends of Halos said in our last session, so I’ll read you the quote. […]

excerpts.t: And then there is an extreme end, shall we say, for the fully self-realized being, but upon the journey there, shall we say, is, as we have said, a dynamic relationship between faith and the rational/intuitive mind. And in that dynamic, evolving relationship, the entity knows when and where and how to apply that mind for its intended function without identification with the world it creates of form and separateness and otherness.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have some queries as these are also somewhat complex, so thank you for bearing with me. The first one is inspired by something that our friends of Halos said in our last session, so I’ll read you the quote. […]
